Parking and Traffic Commission Minutes
 October 24, 2018

  PARKING AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION
  October 24, 2018 Meeting Minutes
  COMMISSIONERS  STAFF MEMBERS
  Michael Benbow  Chairperson  Peter Puglese, T.E., P.E., City Traffic Engineer
  Charles Braggs  Dist. 1  Joi Aldridge, Management Assistant
  Leonel Garcia  Dist. 2  Mario Inga, Interim Parking & Enterprise Services Manager
  Brett C.S. Roberts  Dist. 3  Lieutenant James Kirk
  Barbara Brooks  Dist. 4

  I.  Roll Call of Commissioners and Call to Order by Chairperson
   Meeting called to order by Chairperson Benbow at 7:00 pm
  II.  Approval of Minutes for August Meeting
   Commissioner Leonel Garcia made the motion to accept the minutes
   Commissioner Charles Braggs seconded the motion
   Minutes approved 4-0
 III.  Public Comments (comments not listed on the agenda)
   Inglewood resident came to speak to the commission regarding a permit parking
  district on 82nd and his concerns regarding the entire process.
   Inglewood resident from Crenshaw area requested parking stall lines be drawn on
  her street to eliminate the double parking issue occurring.
   Inglewood resident in the Centinela came to speak to the commission regarding
  speeding issues in her area and requested assistance
   Inglewood residents continued to speak to the commission regarding different
  parking and speeding issues occurring within the city.

 IV.  Unfinished Business: None
  V.  New Business: None

 VI.  Public Hearings: None
VII.  Resolutions: None
VIII.  Referral from City Council or City Departments: None
 IX.  Parking & Traffic Control:
   City Council approved pilot program to reinstate Smart parking meters that will take
  debit/credit cards and cellphones
   Locust St. parking structure will be ready by Christmas 2018 (Please provide
  commission with update)

  X.  Police Department: None
 XI.  Commissioner Initiatives: None

  Page 1 of 2
  Parking and Traffic Commission Minutes
 October 24, 2018

XII.  Announcements:
   Next meeting is tentatively scheduled for January 23, 2019
XIII.  Adjournment
   Meeting was adjourned at 8:15pm.
